parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: Sounds in a poem
steps.prompt: Tap each pair to listen. Do they start the same, or finish the same?

options.label: Drip, drop. They start the same.
Splish, splash. They start the same, and sound like water!

steps.explanation: Poems play with sounds: some words start the same and some words rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Poems play with sounds: some words start the same and some words rhyme.

steps.title: When did it happen?

options.label: It is raining. That is happening now.
It rains a lot in winter. That happens often.

steps.explanation: The same verb with ing, ed or s tells us when: raining, rained, rains.
steps.shortExplanation: The same verb with ing, ed or s tells us when: raining, rained, rains.

steps.title: Hot-day rhymes
steps.prompt: Match each word to the word that rhymes with it.
steps.hint: Say both words aloud and listen to the end.
steps.explanation: Hot and spot, cool and pool, sun and fun, bees and trees rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Hot and spot, cool and pool, sun and fun, bees and trees rhyme.

source.answerKeyText: hot – spot • cool – pool • sun – fun • bees – trees

steps.title: Rhyme or same start?
steps.prompt: Do the words rhyme, or start the same?
steps.hint: Listen to the start, then to the end.
steps.explanation: Drip, drop and splish, splash start the same. Puddles, huddles and play, stay rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Drip, drop and splish, splash start the same. Puddles, huddles and play, stay rhyme.

source.answerKeyText: Rhyme: puddles – huddles, play – stay • Start the same: drip – drop, splish – splash

steps.title: ing verbs
steps.prompt: We are going to the park. Mum is bringing a picnic. Tap the two ing verbs.
steps.hint: Look for the doing words that end with ing.
steps.explanation: Going and bringing are verbs that end with ing.
steps.shortExplanation: Going and bringing are verbs that end with ing.

steps.title: Yesterday
steps.explanation: Yesterday it rained. Ed tells us it already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: Yesterday it rained. Ed tells us it already happened.

source.answerKeyText: a rained • b snowing • c Stop

steps.title: Tomorrow
steps.hint: An ing verb needs a helper like will be.
steps.explanation: Tomorrow it will be snowing. Will be is the helper for an ing verb.
steps.shortExplanation: Tomorrow it will be snowing. Will be is the helper for an ing verb.

source.answerKeyText: a rained • b snowing • c Stop

steps.title: Finish the poem
steps.prompt: It is hot in the sun, I'm having some…
steps.explanation: Fun rhymes with sun, so it finishes the line.
steps.shortExplanation: Fun rhymes with sun, so it finishes the line.

englishVisual.text: It is hot in the sun, I'm having some ___.

steps.title: Finish the poem
steps.prompt: I'll go in the pool, to keep myself…
steps.explanation: Cool rhymes with pool, so it finishes the line.
steps.shortExplanation: Cool rhymes with pool, so it finishes the line.

englishVisual.text: I'll go in the pool, to keep myself ___.

steps.title: Storm words
steps.explanation: Thunder is crashing. Crashing is a noisy ing verb.
steps.shortExplanation: Thunder is crashing. Crashing is a noisy ing verb.

source.answerKeyText: Any ing verb that suits thunder: booming, crashing, banging, rumbling

steps.title: How does Sara feel?
steps.prompt: Sara hid under the blanket and held her teddy tight. How does she feel?
steps.hint: Why would you hide under a blanket?
steps.explanation: Sara hid and held her teddy tight, so she was scared.
steps.shortExplanation: Sara hid and held her teddy tight, so she was scared.

source.answerKeyText: Scared / frightened — she hid and held her teddy tight.

englishVisual.title: Storm
englishVisual.text: The thunder crashed. Sara hid under the blanket and held her teddy tight.

steps.title: My rain poem
steps.prompt: Rain, rain, rain, it is raining… Which word rhymes?
steps.explanation: Again rhymes with rain, so the two lines end with a rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Again rhymes with rain, so the two lines end with a rhyme.

source.answerKeyText: Two lines about rain or sun. Extra praise if the last words rhyme.

englishVisual.text: Rain, rain, rain, it is raining ___.

steps.title: Which pair rhymes?
steps.hint: Listen to the ends of the words.
steps.explanation: Cool and pool end with the same sound, so they rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Cool and pool end with the same sound, so they rhyme.

steps.title: Splish, splash
steps.prompt: Splish, splash are two words that…
steps.hint: Listen to the very start of each word.
steps.explanation: Splish and splash both start with spl, so they start the same.
steps.shortExplanation: Splish and splash both start with spl, so they start the same.

steps.title: A good listener
steps.hint: How do you show someone you are listening?
steps.explanation: A good listener looks at the person talking and does not interrupt.
steps.shortExplanation: A good listener looks at the person talking and does not interrupt.

steps.title: In the puddles
steps.explanation: Yesterday we jumped. Ed tells us it already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: Yesterday we jumped. Ed tells us it already happened.

steps.title: The ing verb
steps.prompt: Mum is bringing a picnic. Which is the ing verb?
steps.explanation: Bringing is the doing word, and it ends with ing.
steps.shortExplanation: Bringing is the doing word, and it ends with ing.

stickers.meaning: Words that play with sounds: rhymes, repeated words, same starts.

goalActivities.text: On a hot day, make up rhymes together: hot, spot, pot; cool, pool, school.
goalActivities.textAr: في يوم حر ألّفوا قوافي مع بعض: hot و spot و pot، و cool و pool و school.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Say pairs of words and your child touches their head if they start the same, or their feet if they rhyme.
goalActivities.textAr: قول كلمتين وطفلك يلمس راسه لو بيبدأوا زي بعض، أو رجليه لو على نفس القافية.

goalActivities.text: While you get ready to go out, say what you are doing with ing verbs: I am putting on my shoes. We are going!
goalActivities.textAr: وانتو بتجهزوا تخرجوا، قولوا بتعملوا إيه بأفعال فيها ing: I am putting on my shoes. We are going!
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Look at the weather each morning. Your child says what it did yesterday and what it is doing now: It rained. It is raining.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على الجو كل يوم الصبح، وطفلك يقول عمل إيه امبارح وبيعمل إيه دلوقتي: It rained. It is raining.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Say the first line of a poem and stop before the last word. Your child finds a rhyming word to finish it.
goalActivities.textAr: قول أول سطر من قصيدة ووقّف قبل آخر كلمة، وطفلك يلاقي كلمة على نفس القافية تكمّلها.

goalActivities.text: Make storm noises with pans and spoons. Your child finds an ing word for each: banging, booming, crashing.
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا أصوات عاصفة بالحلل والمعالق، وطفلك يلاقي كلمة ing لكل صوت: banging و booming و crashing.

goalActivities.text: When you read a story, stop and ask: how does this character feel? How do you know?
goalActivities.textAr: وانتو بتقروا قصة، وقّفوا واسألوا: الشخصية دي حاسّة بإيه؟ وعرفت منين؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Look out of the window together and finish four lines: It's…, I can see…, I can hear…, I feel…. Find two words that rhyme.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا من الشباك مع بعض وكمّلوا أربع سطور: It's… و I can see… و I can hear… و I feel…. ولاقوا كلمتين على نفس القافية.

goalActivities.text: Play rhyme snap: say two words, and your child shouts snap when they rhyme.
goalActivities.textAr: العبوا snap للقوافي: قول كلمتين، وطفلك يقول snap لما يكونوا على نفس القافية.

goalActivities.text: Pour water into a bowl and say splish, splash. Find more water words that start the same: drip, drop.
goalActivities.textAr: صبّوا مية في طبق وقولوا splish, splash. ولاقوا كلمات مية تانية بتبدأ زي بعض: drip و drop.

goalActivities.text: Take turns telling each other about your favourite food. The listener looks at the speaker, waits, then asks one question.
goalActivities.textAr: اتبادلوا تحكوا لبعض عن أكلتكم المفضلة. اللي بيسمع يبص للي بيتكلم، ويستنى، وبعدين يسأل سؤال واحد.

goalActivities.text: Next time it rains, jump in a puddle together. At home your child tells you: we jumped in the puddles!
goalActivities.textAr: المرة الجاية لما تمطر، نطّوا في بركة مية مع بعض. وفي البيت طفلك يحكيلك: we jumped in the puddles!

goalActivities.text: Pack a little picnic together and say what you are doing: I am bringing cups. You are bringing bread.
goalActivities.textAr: جهّزوا نزهة صغيرة مع بعض وقولوا بتعملوا إيه: I am bringing cups. You are bringing bread.

homeActivities.text: Make a kitchen sound poem: tap a pan, let the tap drip, pour water. Your child finds a word for each sound, and the list becomes a poem.
homeActivities.textAr: اعملوا قصيدة أصوات المطبخ: اخبطوا على حلّة، سيبوا الحنفية تنقّط، صبّوا مية. وطفلك يلاقي كلمة لكل صوت، والليستة دي تبقى قصيدة.
